identification.summary: Pumpkin Sandstorm is a Microsoft threat actor name whose origin/threat category is listed as Iran, with DEV-0146 listed as another name in Microsoft's published mapping [S1]. In Microsoft's 2023 weather-based taxonomy, the 'Sandstorm' family denotes Iranian actors and DEV-#### designations are temporary names for emerging or developing clusters [S3]. No Microsoft blog, report, or vendor write-up describing Pumpkin Sandstorm's activity was found in open sources during this research.
identification.notes: Microsoft's MSTIC mapping file lists 'DEV-0146' as another name [S1]. The MISP Galaxy 'Microsoft Activity Group' cluster lists 'DEV-0146' and 'ZeroCleare' as synonyms for Pumpkin Sandstorm, citing Microsoft's naming page and the MSTIC mapping file as references [S2]. ZeroCleare is a wiper malware family, not an actor name: IBM X-Force linked it to ITG13 (APT34/OilRig) plus a second Iran-based group [S5], and Microsoft described it as shared among a small number of affiliated Iranian actors, including actors with links to MOIS [S4]. Do not merge ZeroCleare, APT34, or Albania-attack actors (DEV-0842, DEV-0861, DEV-0166, Europium) into this record without a Microsoft statement linking them [S4].

attribution.sponsor: Iran (country-level origin/threat category assigned by Microsoft; no specific sponsoring organization named) [S1].
attribution.confidence: Microsoft assigns the Iran origin/threat category through its naming taxonomy [S1][S3]; Microsoft has published no confidence statement or sponsoring-entity assessment for Pumpkin Sandstorm found in open sources.
attribution.basis: Microsoft threat actor naming mapping [S1]; Microsoft naming convention in which the Sandstorm family indicates Iran [S3].

targeting.notes: No open-source reporting on Pumpkin Sandstorm targeting was found. For the ZeroCleare association listed by MISP [S2], the relevant historical ZeroCleare victimology is Middle East energy and industrial organizations (2019) [S5]; this is not attributed to Pumpkin Sandstorm by Microsoft.

diamond.adversary: Iran-origin actor tracked by Microsoft as Pumpkin Sandstorm, formerly DEV-0146 [S1][S3].

gaps: No Microsoft blog, Digital Defense Report section, or Defender threat-analytics profile describing Pumpkin Sandstorm/DEV-0146 activity was found; several searches for 'DEV-0146' returned no relevant results.
Microsoft's official threat actor naming page (learn.microsoft.com) could not be fetched; the mapping was verified only via Microsoft's MSTIC GitHub mapping file [S1].

ZeroCleare is a malware family with separate IBM X-Force (APT34/ITG13-linked) [S5] and Microsoft (MOIS-linked actors, Albania 2022 context) [S4] reporting; the nature of its relationship to Pumpkin Sandstorm (alias label vs. confirmed tool use) is not described in available Microsoft reporting.
First-observed date, sponsoring organization (MOIS vs IRGC), objectives, targeted sectors/regions, tooling, infrastructure, and any named campaigns are unknown.
No MITRE ATT&CK group entry is mapped to Pumpkin Sandstorm; attack.mitre.org could not be fetched to check ZeroCleare (S1151) group associations.
Exact publication dates of the MSTIC mapping file and MISP cluster entries could not be confirmed (GitHub commit history not accessible); access dates are used.
